meta.title: Web search
meta.description: Multi-backend search with explicit anonymous or key access, cost tiers, bounded retries and complete Web settings. Backends start disabled; account-backed requests may incur charges.

title: Web search
loadFailed: Could not load settings. Reload to try again.
saveUnconfirmed: Save could not be confirmed. Reload settings before saving again; do not assume the operation failed.
conflict: Saved configuration differs from your draft. Review the latest state before saving again.
actionFailed: The operation could not be confirmed. Search tests are never automatically replayed.
invalidField: Enter a valid value within the documented limits.
expectedRange: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
blockersTitle: This configuration will not search yet
blockNoBackends: No backend is enabled, so every search fails immediately.
blockMissingCredential: Key mode without a stored credential: {{list}}.
backendIntro: Cost groups reflect the selected access mode. Modes are explicit: no automatic key selection, paid upgrade, or fallback.
unverifiedHelp: This backend has no verified API contract and cannot be enabled. An endpoint or credential does not make it supported.
anonymousNoCredential: Anonymous mode sends no credential; stored keys are not read.
deleteCredentialConfirm: Delete this saved credential? This cannot be undone.
credentialFailed: Credential change could not be confirmed. The input has been cleared; inspect the current state before trying again.
testHelp: Each click sends one explicit test request using saved settings. Usage may be billed. Save changes first; failed tests are not automatically replayed by this page.
testNeedsBackend: Save an enabled backend first; tests only use saved configuration.
diagnosticsHelp: Recent request outcomes. Clearing diagnostics does not reset daily attempt budgets.
transferHelp: Export removes endpoint query strings and sensitive option values. Credential references are retained, but saved secrets are never included. Review imported endpoints and references before saving.
imported: Imported into the draft. Review and save to apply.
importFailed: Invalid JSON. Your current draft was kept.
defaultsConfirm: Replace your draft with defaults? Nothing is saved until you choose Save.
defaultsRestored: Defaults loaded into the draft. Save to apply.
help.maxResults: Maximum merged sources returned to the caller.
help.overallTimeoutMs: Deadline for the entire search, including retries.
help.language: Chosen from a fixed list. Each backend receives its own spelling (Brave zh-hans, Serper zh-cn, SearXNG zh-CN); backends that ignore the field say so.
help.region: Chosen from a fixed list of two-letter regions. Only backends that declare region support receive it, in their own format.
help.recency: Applied where supported by the selected API.
help.safeSearch: Request safer results where the backend supports it.
help.includeDomains: Comma-separated domains; leave empty for no allowlist.
help.dedup: Merge duplicates by normalized URL, or URL and title.
help.fusion: Combine ranking by reciprocal rank or preserve backend order.
help.retry.enabled: Configured HTTP retries can incur repeated charges. This page never replays a test action automatically.
help.retry.statuses: Only these response codes are retried, on the same backend and access mode.
help.retry.maxRetries: Additional attempts after the initial request.
help.retry.networkErrors: A failed response may still have incurred usage.
help.retry.timeouts: A timed-out request may still have incurred usage.
help.breaker.enabled: Temporarily pause a backend after repeated failures.
help.breaker.threshold: Failures required to open the circuit.
help.breaker.cooldownMs: Time before a backend can be attempted again.
help.cache.enabled: Reuse matching search results within the configured lifetime.
help.diagnostics.maxEntries: Limit the number of retained diagnostic records.
help.backend.enabled: Only explicitly enabled, verified backends can execute searches.
help.backend.mode: Choose a fixed anonymous or key mode. No automatic switching.
help.backend.endpoint: Use a trusted HTTPS endpoint, or a trusted local self-hosted endpoint. Never put secrets in the URL.
help.backend.rateLimitPerMinute: Local attempt guard, not a provider billing guarantee.
help.backend.dailyAttemptLimit: Local daily attempt budget; retries also consume attempts.
testQueryPlaceholder: What should this backend look for?
activeTitle: This plugin is not the active search provider
activeOther: The web seam currently selects “{{provider}}”. Searches keep going there until this plugin is selected.
activateSelf: Use this plugin for web search
colorLegend: Green: free path, own account or self-hosted. Yellow: free allowance. Red: trial credits or paid. Sorted cheapest first.
credentialPending: Wait for the current action to finish.
credentialReadOnly: This credential is provided by another source and cannot be changed here.
help.tools.webSearchPlus: Off hides the tool entirely: the agent then searches only through the configured strategy.
help.tools.compactByDefault: Sources carry only URL, title and date. Saves context when the agent only needs links; a call can still ask for full snippets.
help.browser.endpoint: The Playwright endpoint every browser-backed reader shares, for example ws://<host>:3000/ws. When set it wins over a backend's own endpoint; leave it empty to let each backend name its own.
help.browser.statePath: Optional. Where the browser container writes the signed-in session; empty uses the search core default.
help.browser.timeoutMs: How long one browser read may take.
help.browser.maxConcurrentReads: How many browser reads may run at once on one site. This differs from “Parallel concurrency” under “Search behavior”: that setting bounds search requests across providers, while this bounds reads on the one shared browser page. A 429 rate-limit answer lowers it to 1 for the rest of that browser session; it is a local safety bound, not a site quota.
sharedBrowserHint: This block describes the browser container you host: its endpoint, its endpoint token, the session file, the read timeout and the per-site read cap. Every backend in browser mode shares it.
browserTokenHelp: Used to connect to the browser service. Sign in to Xiaohongshu through VNC.
browserInheritedEndpoint: This backend inherits the shared endpoint: {{endpoint}}
browserInheritedEndpointMissing: This backend has no endpoint to connect to: the shared browser settings are empty and it names none of its own.
browserOwnEndpoint: The shared browser endpoint is empty, so this backend uses its own endpoint: {{endpoint}}.
browserInheritedHint: The endpoint and the token both come from the shared browser settings, so they are changed in one place.
browserOverride: Give this backend its own endpoint (fallback only)
browserOverrideHint: Applies only while the shared browser settings are empty. Use it to point one backend at a different browser container.
help.tools.webExtract: Off hides the tool entirely, so an agent with a stronger native fetch tool never receives a duplicate. Fetch configuration, credentials and this page stay available.
help.pageFetch.overallTimeoutMs: Bounds the whole route chain. Cancellation, this deadline, target policy and acquisition limits are fatal and never fall back to another route.
help.pageFetch.maxRedirects: Redirects are followed one hop at a time and every hop is re-checked against the target policy.
help.pageFetch.maxBodyBytes: An acquisition limit, not an output truncation: exceeding it stops the fetch instead of returning a partial page.
help.pageFetch.maxOutputChars: The returned page is truncated at this length and the result says so.
help.pageFetch.maxRuleScanChars: Fallback rules never inspect more than this many characters of one field, and the diagnostic says when a field was truncated.
help.pageFetch.allowPrivateNetworks: Off by default. With it off, local names, private addresses and names that resolve to them are refused before a connection is made.
help.pageFetch.allowDelegatedFetching: A browser or provider resolves the target outside this process, so the local address check cannot prove where it lands. Enabling that route requires this explicit opt-in.
help.pageFetch.browser.context: Isolated opens a fresh context without saved site login state. Session loads the configured state file, which carries the privacy implications of that account.
help.pageFetch.browser.settleMs: An optional bounded wait after DOMContentLoaded. There is no unbounded network-idle wait.
help.pageFetch.browser.selectorWait: Optional. When it does not appear within the route timeout, the captured DOM may be incomplete and the result says so.
fetchToolHelp: web_extract returns one page as Markdown (for reading) or HTML (for structure). The format is required on every call, and returned page content is always untrusted data.
fetchReady: The saved fetch chain can run.
fetchReadyHelp: Checked from configuration and stored credentials only; nothing is fetched and no provider is called.
problem.fetchNoRoutes: No route is enabled, so every page fetch fails.
problem.fetchDelegatedOff: A browser or provider route is enabled without the delegated-fetching opt-in, so a fetch is refused.
problem.fetchBrowserNoEndpoint: The browser route is enabled but no shared browser endpoint is set.
problem.fetchProviderMissing: The provider route is enabled but no fetch-capable provider is selected.
problem.fetchProviderCredential: {{provider}} needs a stored credential for its saved fetch access mode.
fetchRoutesHelp: Exactly one record per route. They run one at a time in this order; a disabled route is skipped and a matched fallback rule moves on to the next one.
fetchRouteHelp.browser: Rendered DOM from the shared browser.
fetchTimeoutHelp: This route gives up after this long; a timeout rule can then fall back to the next route.
fetchRulesHelp: Rules are OR; conditions inside one rule are AND. A condition may be true, false or unavailable, and a missing field never counts as an empty string. A Markdown condition reads native provider Markdown, or the converted Markdown of the HTTP/browser route when the requested format is markdown; with format html that field is unavailable.
fetchPresetsHelp: Presets are ordinary editable rules. The challenge preset combines a title and an HTML marker as a heuristic; it never triggers on the word "cloudflare" alone and does not solve a challenge.
fetchProviderHelp: Selecting a provider does not change whether it participates in search, and selecting it never sends a request on its own.
fetchProviderMarkdownOnly: This provider returns Markdown only. Asking for HTML skips it without sending a request, and the next enabled route serves the page instead.
fetchModeHelp: Only modes verified for fetching can be selected. Fetching may use a different mode and endpoint than searching.
fetchEndpointHelp: Deliberately separate from the search endpoint. An existing search URL is never rewritten into a fetch URL.
fetchProviderTimeoutHelp: Bound on one provider call, capped by the route timeout.
fetchTestHelp: A user-triggered test on the saved configuration. It can reach the network and a provider may meter the call; nothing runs automatically.
matchField.title: title
credentialNotRequired: No credential needed for this mode
fetchProviderFields: Rules that read title, target status or HTML stay unavailable on a provider that does not return them; the attempt trace names each unavailable field.
